Subdued Late Surgers.desc_en: Slightly increase fatigue for late surgers early-race.

Subdued Pace Chasers.desc_en: Slightly increase fatigue for pace chasers early-race.

Sublimated Thunder.desc_en: Slightly surge ahead when positioned toward the back on the final straight late-race.

Summer Gust.desc_en: Increase performance in summer races, increasing Speed and Power.

Summer Halation.desc_en: Moderately increase velocity for a moderate duration when well-positioned on a corner in the second half of the race. If at Nakayama Racecourse, also increase acceleration based on Speed.

Sun's Blessing.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when engaging in a challenge mid-race. Increase this skill's effectiveness based on the number of skills the user has learned.

Sunny Breeze.desc_en: Very minimally increase acceleration continuously for a long duration when toward the front on the latter half of the final corner after biding time in the race's first half. Effect increases if 2nd.

Sunny Days ○.desc_en: Moderately increase performance in sunny weather.

Sunny Sign.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front upon approaching late-race. (Dirt)

Sunrise Banner—Katsuragi Ace!.desc_en: Very slightly increase velocity and very slightly recover endurance when leading on the third corner. If it's a medium-distance race at Tokyo Racecourse, increase this skill's duration.

Super Lucky Seven.desc_en: Good things may happen when in bracket 7.

Super-Duper Climax.desc_en: Slightly recover endurance with a glance at nearby runners when positioned toward the back on the final corner.

Super-Duper Stoked.desc_en: Slightly recover endurance with a glance at nearby runners when positioned toward the back on the final corner.

Superior Heal.desc_en: Moderately recover endurance when overtaken toward the back mid-race.

Superstan.desc_en: Increase velocity when close to many runners.

Sure Shot.desc_en: Increase velocity when positioned toward the back upon approaching late-race. (Long)

Swinging Maestro.desc_en: Recover endurance on a corner with efficient turning.

Sympathy.desc_en: Moderately increase performance when many runners share a sympathetic heart.

THE MOE AAAA Thanks for My Life.name_en: THE MOE AAAA Thanks for My Life
THE MOE AAAA Thanks for My Life.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when positioned midpack or further back on a mid-race corner and there are at least 3 runners nearby.

Tactical Tweak.desc_en: Slightly increase acceleration when positioned toward the back mid-race. (Pace Chaser)

Tail Held High.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity after activating many skills mid-race.

Tail Nine.desc_en: Increase velocity after activating many skills mid-race.

Take the Chance.desc_en: Slightly increase acceleration when positioned midpack or further back in the early part of late-race. (Medium)

Taking the Lead.desc_en: Increase ability to go to the front early-race. (Front Runner)

Tantalizing Trick.desc_en: Increase fatigue for rushed runners behind when positioned toward the front mid-race.

Target in Sight ○.desc_en: Moderately increase performance when the favorite is using the same strategy.

Target in Sight ◎.desc_en: Increase performance when the favorite is using the same strategy.

Technician.desc_en: Moderately increase ability to navigate smoothly. (Pace Chaser)

Tether.desc_en: Slightly decrease velocity of runners ahead when positioned toward the back late-race. (Medium)

The Bigger Picture.desc_en: Widen field of view with heightened observation mid-race. (Late Surger)

The Coast Is Clear!.desc_en: Moderately widen field of view with situational awareness when moving sideways. (End Closer)

The Duty of Dignity Calls.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on the final corner. If still going strong in a long-distance race, increase velocity moderately instead.

The View from the Lead Is Mine!.name_en: The View from the Lead Is Mine!
The View from the Lead Is Mine!.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when in the lead by a fair margin in the second half of the race.

This Dance Is for Vittoria!.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front and close to the runner ahead or behind on the final corner or later.

Thunderbolt Step.desc_en: Moderately avoid becoming surrounded for a medium duration mid-race. (Medium)

Ticket to Your Dreams!.desc_en: Very slightly increase velocity steadily when in midpack or further back on the final straight in the last spurt. Effect increases when activating a skill (up to 3 times).

Tokyo Racecourse ×.desc_en: Moderately decrease performance at Tokyo Racecourse.

Tokyo Racecourse ○.desc_en: Moderately increase performance at Tokyo Racecourse.

Top Gear.desc_en: Greatly increase velocity when positioned 2nd or further back within 4 lengths of the lead on the final straight. (Late Surger)

Top Pick.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when engaged in a challenge mid-race. (Dirt)

Top Runner.desc_en: Increase ability to pass or challenge another runner early-race or mid-race. (Front Runner)

Towards the Scenery I Seek.desc_en: Moderately increase performance in pursuit of that long sought-after scenery.

Trackblazer.desc_en: Decrease fatigue when positioned toward the front mid-race. (Medium)

Trending in the Charts!.desc_en: Increase velocity when engaged in a challenge mid-race. (Dirt)

Trick (Front).desc_en: Slightly increase fatigue for rushed runners behind when positioned toward the front mid-race.

Trick (Rear).desc_en: Slightly increase fatigue for rushed runners ahead when positioned toward the back mid-race.

Triumphant Pulse.desc_en: Moderately increase ability to break out of the pack when positioned toward the front with 200m remaining.

Tumbly Power Drive!.desc_en: Very slightly increase velocity for a duration based on remaining endurance when in midpack on a second-half corner. If the race is medium, also very minimally increase acceleration.

Turbo BLAST!.desc_en: Minimally increase velocity continuously for an extremely long duration when leading by a fair margin halfway through mid-race, but very slightly lose steam at the end of late-race.

U=ma2.desc_en: Slightly recover endurance and very slightly increase velocity for a moderate duration when sitting off the pace on a corner in the second half of the race.

Uma Stan.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when close to many runners.

Unchanging.desc_en: Greatly increase performance with the same ambition of days past.

Undistracted.desc_en: Slightly recover endurance and very slightly increase velocity mid-race. (Long)

Unquenched Thirst.desc_en: Moderately increase performance with the desire to race.

Unrestrained.desc_en: Increase ability to keep the lead on the final corner. (Front Runner)

Unrestrained Passion.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when positioned midpack or further back upon approaching mid-race. (Late Surger)

Unyielding.desc_en: Increase velocity and very slightly increase acceleration when pressured on the final corner or later. (Medium)

Up-Tempo.desc_en: Slightly increase positioning ability when positioned toward the front mid-race. (Medium)

Updrafters.desc_en: Slightly increase passing ability when positioned toward the back late-race. (Mile)

Us Girlies Keep Winnin'! ♪.desc_en: Very slightly increase velocity continuously when positioned midpack around halfway through the race. Increase this skill's effectiveness when the user's mood is great.

V Is for Victory!.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on the final straight after engaging in a challenge on the final corner or later.

VIP Pass.desc_en: Decrease fatigue when determined to pass another runner. (Long)

Vanguard Spirit.desc_en: Increase ability to maintain the lead when leading by a fair margin mid-race. (Long)

Victoria por plancha ☆.desc_en: Very slightly hang on to the advantage when positioned toward the front with energy to spare on the final straight.

Victory Cheer!.desc_en: Very slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on the third corner in the second half of the race. Or, very slightly kick forward when toward the front on the backstretch late-race.

Victory belongs to me—Strelitzia! ☆.desc_en: If positioned toward the back and racing calmly until the start of the final corner, when there are 300m remaining, slightly increase velocity continuously.

Vying for the Throne.desc_en: When positioned midpack or further back on the final corner, slightly decrease the velocity of 3 runners ahead and 3 behind. Increase skill user's velocity. (Late Surger)

Wait-and-See.desc_en: Slightly decrease fatigue and very slightly increase acceleration when positioned toward the back mid-race. (Sprint)

Wallflower.desc_en: Moderately decrease performance when many other runners are using the same strategy.

Warning Shot!.desc_en: Very slightly increase velocity steadily with a long spurt starting halfway through the race.

Watch! Me! BLOOM!.desc_en: If the skill user engaged in a challenge mid-race, slightly increase acceleration continuously when well-positioned with 650m remaining.

Watchful Eye.desc_en: Slightly decrease fatigue, then very slightly decrease velocity of runners ahead when positioned toward the back upon approaching mid-race. (Mile)

Wet Conditions ×.desc_en: Moderately decrease performance on good, soft, and heavy ground.

Wet Conditions ○.desc_en: Moderately increase performance on good, soft, and heavy ground.

Wet Conditions ◎.desc_en: Increase performance on good, soft, and heavy ground.

Where There's a Will, There's a Way.name_en: Where There's a Will, There's a Way
Where There's a Will, There's a Way.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when passing another runner toward the back on the final straight.

Wherever This Wonder Leads.desc_en: If positioned midpack on a downhill just before late-race and there's a large distance left to the finish, slightly increase velocity.

White Lightning Comin' Through!.desc_en: Slightly bolt down the track when well-positioned or aiming for the front from midpack on a straight in the second half of the race.

Wild Wind.desc_en: When positioned toward the front mid-race, increase velocity and slightly decrease the velocity of runners behind the user. (Medium)

Wisdom of the Earth.desc_en: Increase velocity around halfway through late-race. Increase this skill's effectiveness based on the number of skills the user has learned.

Wisdom of the Sea.desc_en: Increase acceleration in the early part of early-race. Increase this skill's effectiveness based on the number of skills the user has learned.

Wisdom of the Sun.desc_en: Increase velocity when engaging in a challenge mid-race. Increase this skill's effectiveness based on the number of skills the user has learned.

With All My Soul.desc_en: When positioned toward the front mid-race, slightly increase velocity and minimally decrease the velocity of runners behind the user. (Medium)

World in Bloom.desc_en: Very slightly increase velocity when positioned midpack halfway through the race. If it's a long-distance race, increase this skill's duration and moderately recover endurance.

Xceleration.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front with 200m or less remaining.

YUMMY☆SPEED!.desc_en: Very slightly kick forward when moderately tired while well-positioned halfway through the race.

Yodo Invicta.desc_en: Increase performance at Kyoto Racecourse, increasing Stamina, Wit, and Speed.

You and Me! One-on-One!.desc_en: Slightly increase velocity on the final straight after passing another runner on the outside toward the back on the final corner or later.

You're Not the Boss of Me!.name_en: You're Not the Boss of Me!
You're Not the Boss of Me!.desc_en: Increase time lost to slow starts and moderately decrease Wit.

You've Got No Shot.desc_en: Cause panic in and moderately dull movement for runners ahead when positioned toward the back early-race. (Sprint)

Your Smile Sparkles as the Waves.name_en: Your Smile Sparkles as the Waves
Your Smile Sparkles as the Waves.desc_en: When positioned in the front part of the pack in the second half of the race, start a long spurt based on remaining endurance, minimally increasing velocity continuously.

trigger:BEAT.desc_en: When near the inner rail midpack on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity and ability to navigate smoothly on the final straight.

α-star*.desc_en: Very slightly increase velocity steadily when positioned toward the lead around halfway through the race. Also very slightly recover endurance if it's a dirt race.

∴win Q.E.D..desc_en: Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on the final corner or later late-race. If the skill user ran calmly, increase velocity moderately instead.

♡ 3D Nail Art.desc_en: Moderately decrease performance on firm ground.
